m.d: A transliteration of the Russian or Serbo-Croatian female given name Екатерина (Jekaterina), equivalent to Catherine.
Chiefly in the form eke out: to add to, to augment; to increase; to lengthen.
A spacer put between or over or under hive parts to make more space.
The act or process of adding.
A small vehicle used in India, pulled by a single horse.
